q: How long does a Reset Clean take on a McLaren GT?
a: This McLaren GT took 3.5 hours on site in Glen Iris. A Reset Clean is an interior and exterior package, and we allow about 3 to 3.5 hours depending on the condition of the car.

q: Does a Reset Clean include paint correction?
a: No. A Reset Clean cleans the interior and exterior but does not polish out swirl marks or scratches. Paint correction can be added to a Reset Clean, and we quote it after inspecting the car.

q: Do you come to me to detail a McLaren?
a: Yes. SQKY is mobile, and this McLaren GT was detailed on site in Glen Iris, so the car never had to be driven anywhere. We confirm access and space with you before the visit.

q: How is a Reset Clean different from a corner car wash?
a: A Reset Clean is a booked, one-car-at-a-time interior and exterior detail done at your location, so the result does not depend on how busy the day is. This owner switched to us after inconsistent results from a corner car wash.
